page_title: PAL 2-0 VAL | Las Palmas v Valencia 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90+5' 2 - 0 Goal! Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Giorgi Mamardashvili and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 2:0.
90+5' A pass from Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) is intercepted by Giorgi Mamardashvili and the move breaks down.
90+3' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Javier Munoz and he is replaced by Fabio Gonzalez (Las Palmas).
90+2' Substitution. Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) on for Marvin.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 0 Goal! Marc Cardona gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) climbs highest and powers a close-range header inside the left post. 1:0.
89' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
88' Marvin (Las Palmas) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Las Palmas have a corner.
88' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
87' 1:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
86' Ruben Baraja decides to make a substitution. Hugo Duro will be replaced by Alberto Mari (Valencia).
84' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
83' Substitution. Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) has come on for Munir El Haddadi.
83' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
80' Here is a change. Sandro Ramirez is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas).
80' That's the end of the game for Maximo Perrone, who is replaced by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas).

76' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
74' Jose Gaya (Valencia) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Hugo Duro, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
74' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. Sergi Canos (Valencia) replaces Fran Perez.
74' A substitution has been made. Javi Guerra goes off and Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) comes on.
72' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
69' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
67' It will be a substitution. Peter Gonzalez (Valencia) is ready to enter the pitch as Selim Amallah walks off.
66' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
64' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Giorgi Mamardashvili, who smothers the ball.
62' Wonderful movement by Las Palmas. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
60' The corner from Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is cleared away by the defence.
60' Marvin (Las Palmas) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Las Palmas.
59' 73:27 – the ratio of ball possession.
55' That looked a certain handball by Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
54' The attendance for today's match is 25633.

53' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) sends in a cross from the free-kick from the edge of the box. His effort is inaccurate and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
52' Fran Perez (Valencia) trips an opposition player and Guillermo Cuadra signals a foul. That's a free kick to Las Palmas.
51' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
48' Yellow card. Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
46' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' Guillermo Cuadra has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

45' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Las Palmas.
45' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul after Pepelu (Valencia) hacks down one of his opponents. Las Palmas have a free kick.

43' What a chance that is! Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
43' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick is awarded to Valencia.
40' Jose Gaya (Valencia) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
37' Hugo Duro (Valencia) commits a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for an infringement.
34' Total attempts – 2:3.
31' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
29' The linesman signals that Selim Amallah (Valencia) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
26' Fran Perez (Valencia) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
24' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Las Palmas will have a throw-in.
23' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner with a short pass.
23' An attempted cross from Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) is cleared.
22' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is behind the touchline and Valencia will take a throw-in.
20' Pepelu (Valencia) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.

19' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball has crossed the sideline. Las Palmas are taking a throw-in.
17' A clumsy foul by Marvin (Las Palmas) and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle.
16' Pepelu (Valencia) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
13' Hugo Duro (Valencia) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Alvaro Valles.
10' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
7' Selim Amallah (Valencia) makes a slide tackle, but referee Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul.
7' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and signals a foul after Hugo Duro (Valencia) brought his opponent down. Las Palmas are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
6' Las Palmas seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
5' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
4' Fran Perez (Valencia) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
2' Half-chance! Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) plays a pass into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili reacts well to snuff out the attack.
1' The match has just started.
Valencia will kick the game off.
Guillermo Cuadra is the one to supervise the game today.
